source: Research-lead decision cites Dukascopy Bank SA official USATECH.IDX/USD trading-hours table
summer_clock: Europe/Zurich daylight-saving status selects the lead's summer/winter published UTC schedule.
known_holiday_filter: Conservatively require an XNAS session on weekdays using installed exchange_calendars 4.13.2; Sunday weekly open remains eligible. This is a predeclared proxy filter, not an asserted Dukascopy special-hours calendar.
bar_boundary_rule: Signal, entry and exit 30m intervals must each finish before the schedule closes; a 20:00 summer UTC start before a 20:15 close is not a complete 30m bar.
surprise_gap_policy: After signal eligibility is fixed, a missing actual scheduled t+1 or t+2 bar blocks the whole trial with EXECUTION_EXCEPTION. No signal is dropped based on future provider-bar presence.
limitations: Official broker special-holiday hours were not available in a machine-readable historical feed.
Early-close dates are not modeled and will fail closed if a selected fill is absent.
